name: capacitor-chrome-preview-geometry-probe
description: Non-published measurement app for validating Capacitor Chrome Preview device geometry.

scripts.build:android: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath .tmp/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
